description: Pinned source records for Elementary's upstream metapackage generation inputs. These inputs are separate from the 59 candidate image-package repositories.

generator_contract.reference_generator: Germinate (Ubuntu package; source revision not yet pinned)
generator_contract.behavior_status: An independently authored Rust candidate composes explicitly supplied seed collections, resolves inheritance and blacklists, parses Debian binary Packages metadata, expands source names to binaries, and computes basic dependency closure through an integrated profile command. Recommends feature behavior is implemented for the selected seed; remaining Germinate build-dependency features, apt/Germinate differential parity, archive precedence/conflict semantics, and Debian output parity remain open.
generator_contract.license_gate: Do not vendor upstream seed files into the local Rust project; load the separately pinned input at build time and review licensing before redistributing source or generated seed data.

license.evidence: The pinned repository tree has no LICENSE, COPYING, or COPYRIGHT file, and GitHub repository metadata declares no license.
